What registering this body would decide: accepted (with the run's platform and windows),
refused (with the reason per target) or invalid. Creates no run, event, refusal or alert, so a
launcher's dry run is invisible to triage.
created -> started: the windows start now. 409 in any other state.

Report how the test executed on a started run. A non-zero exit code or an error moves it to
error. 409 in any other state.

The test's cleanup begins now, on a started run: detections whose event time is at or after
it are attributed as the cleanup's and left out of the run's candidates and expectations. Once
per run; 409 in any other state or the second time.

created or started -> canceled. A canceled run keeps attributing until its attribution window
ends; one canceled before it started is closed at once. 409 in any other state.

query.title: Query
query.description: free text for the semantic lanes, plus any number of `field:value` terms. A term is `tag:phish`, `uuid:<alert uuid>`, `<observable type>:<value>` (e.g. `ipv4:1.2.3.4`, `signature_id:<uuid>`), `observable:<type>:<value>` for values containing colons, or a filter slug such as `queue:default`, `disposition:DELIVERY`, `alert_date:-7d` or `detection_point:<signature uuid>[:<version>]`. Prefix with `-` to invert, quote a value containing a space or comma, separate ORed values with commas. An unrecognized prefix is ordinary text. A bare word or indicator is searched semantically only -- it never runs an exact lookup.

AlertSearchRequest.title: AlertSearchRequest
AlertSearchRequest.description:
Hybrid search over alerts: exact matches for the things named with a `field:value` term,
plus semantic matches over the alert's text (description, comments, detections, email
content, command lines, ...).

Either `query` or `filters` is required. With filters and no query the response is a plain
newest-first listing: no ranking, and every result's `tier` is null.

excluded_test_alerts.title: Excluded Test Alerts

errors.title: Errors
errors.description: query language problems. When this is non-empty nothing was searched: a term that cannot be honored is reported rather than dropped, because dropping it would return MORE alerts than were asked for

tier.title: Tier
tier.description: the evidence behind the match: exact = a field term matched verbatim; strong = clearly similar text (or similar text sharing terms with the query); good = similar text above the floor; weak = only a term in common. null on a filter-only request, which is a listing rather than a ranking

ApiKeySelfWrite.title: ApiKeySelfWrite
ApiKeySelfWrite.description:
A user's request to create or change one of their OWN keys. Self-service keys are always
scoped -- only an admin mints a key that inherits its owner's full permissions -- so there is
no inherit field, and this is deliberately not ApiKeyCreate with one removed.

ApiKeyUpdate.title: ApiKeyUpdate
ApiKeyUpdate.description:
Request to change an existing key's name and scope. The scope is replaced wholesale, under
the same exactly-one-of rule as creation. The secret itself never changes: editing a key
is how a deployed credential gets new permissions without being reissued.

Per-pair result, positionally aligned with the request (key on index, not value: the
echoed type/value are the normalized forms, e.g. a lowercased file hash).

Only alerts in the default queue are counted, and alerts with alert_type 'faqueue' never
are. disposition_counts is the raw histogram including OPEN and UNKNOWN (unlike the GUI's
disposition history, which drops UNKNOWN), so total_alert_count ==
sum(disposition_counts.values()) always holds. found=false with error=null means the
observable has never been indexed; found=true with total_alert_count=0 means every
containing alert was in another queue, faqueue, excluded, or before since. Event
memberships are not filtered by queue.

capture_count.title: Capture Count
capture_count.description: how many captures (one per alert) the sample has

stored.title: Stored
stored.description: how many captures hold the file

missing.title: Missing
missing.description: how many captures could not keep the file (state missing)

missing_data.title: Missing Data
missing_data.description: how many captures lack something: the file, or the match record

unknown_version.title: Unknown Version
unknown_version.description: how many captures recorded signature version 'unknown'

updated_at.title: Updated At
updated_at.description: the latest change of any of its captures

label.title: Label
label.description: the sample's grade for the rule, aggregated from the verdicts of its contributing detections: tp, fp, or conflicted when votes of the strongest strength present disagree; null when no detection has a verdict

label_source.title: Label Source
label_source.description: the strength that decided the label: explicit > inherited_single > inherited_multi

retired.title: Retired
retired.description: whether the sample is retired for its rule: YARA validation only counts it

retired_by.title: Retired By
retired_by.description: who retired it, while it is retired

local.title: Local
local.description: whether this node can serve the file: always with a shared pool

SampleRow.title: SampleRow
SampleRow.description:
One sample: a file and a YARA rule it matched, over every alert it was captured from.

Timestamps are UTC.

SampleVotes.title: SampleVotes
SampleVotes.description: How many contributing detections vote TP or FP, at each strength (verdict source).

quick_filter.title: Quick Filter
quick_filter.description: pin as a quick filter badge

quick_filter_indicator.title: Quick Filter Indicator
quick_filter_indicator.description: show an alert count on the badge

SavedFilterRead.title: SavedFilterRead
SavedFilterRead.description: A saved filter as returned to callers.

ScratchFilterWrite.title: ScratchFilterWrite
ScratchFilterWrite.description: Replace the caller's singleton `working` or `temp` row.

insert_date_start.title: Insert Date Start
insert_date_start.description: only alerts created at or after this time (timezone-aware)

insert_date_end.title: Insert Date End
insert_date_end.description: only alerts created at or before this time (timezone-aware)

observables.title: Observables
observables.description: only alerts carrying ALL of these observables; the value is normalized the same way the analysis engine normalizes it, and a file observable's value is its content sha256 hex digest

detection_points.title: Detection Points
detection_points.description: only alerts with a detection point from ANY of these signatures, each written <signature uuid>[:<signature version>]; without a version any version matches

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: the rest of the alert management filter vocabulary, in the same {name, inverted, values} shape the GUI and share links use -- e.g. {"name": "Owner", "inverted": true, "values": ["None"]}

SearchFiltersBody.title: SearchFiltersBody
SearchFiltersBody.description:
Filters applied before ranking. Lists match any of their values; the filters themselves
are ANDed together.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: alert, comment, detection, analysis, context (semantic) or observable, tag, uuid (lexical)

score.title: Score
score.description: lane-native score: 1.0 for an exact match, the fused qdrant score for a semantic hit; not comparable across lanes

SecretEntry.title: SecretEntry
SecretEntry.description: One named secret and its status. Never includes the value.

owner_id.title: Owner Id
owner_id.description: the user who gets the alerts: the caller's own id takes them, null unassigns them

take_owned.title: Take Owned
take_owned.description: alert uuid -> id of the analyst the caller agreed to take it from. An alert another analyst owns is changed only when it is named here with that analyst; otherwise it is left alone and reported in `skipped`.

applied.title: Applied
applied.description: the alerts that now have the requested owner, in the order asked for

skipped.title: Skipped
skipped.description: alert uuid -> display name of the analyst left owning it

message.title: Message
message.description: what the GUI tells the analyst when alerts were skipped; null otherwise

statuses.title: Statuses
statuses.description: its status in each of the runs, in their order: as reviewed for a reviewed run, else live; null when it isn't in that run's result

rows.title: Rows
rows.description: every row of the signature, retired ones included

measured.title: Measured
measured.description: the techniques the signature is measured on now, with the tests that measure it, computed at the request

SignatureWorklist.title: SignatureWorklist
SignatureWorklist.description: A signature's worklist rows, and what it is measured on now.

include_test_alerts.title: Include Test Alerts
include_test_alerts.description: include test-run alerts (the svs.queue queue, docs/SVS_RUNS.md). They are left out by default unless the filters or the query name a queue; excluded_test_alerts in the response says how many were

SimilarAlertsRequest.title: SimilarAlertsRequest
SimilarAlertsRequest.description: Alerts most similar to a given alert, by the alert's own indexed text.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: why this detection could not take the verdict

StatusUpdate.title: StatusUpdate
StatusUpdate.description: Body for updating an event's status.

uuid.title: Uuid
uuid.description: the uuid of the new root (and of its alert, in correlation mode)

missing.title: Missing
missing.description: expected signatures missing from the signed-off results, possibly suppressed ones included

share.title: Share
share.description: possibly_suppressed / missing; null while nothing is missing

reviewed_runs.title: Reviewed Runs
reviewed_runs.description: the runs with a signed-off result

first_reviewed_at.title: First Reviewed At
first_reviewed_at.description: when the first run was reviewed

trigger_reached.title: Trigger Reached
trigger_reached.description: 50 runs are reviewed, or 90 days passed since the first review

reconsider.title: Reconsider
reconsider.description: the trigger is reached and more than 10% of the missing signatures were possibly suppressed: preventing suppression is worth reconsidering

SuppressionShare.title: SuppressionShare
SuppressionShare.description:
How many of the expected signatures missing from reviewed runs were possibly suppressed: the
trigger to revisit keeping the hunter from suppressing test targets (docs/SVS.md, Part 3, *Hunt
suppression*). Read from every run's result as signed off.

alert_uuids.title: Alert Uuids
alert_uuids.description: the targets of every observable in these alerts

TargetLookupRequest.title: TargetLookupRequest
TargetLookupRequest.description: The alerts, or the observables, to find the remediation targets of: exactly one of the two.

technique.title: Technique
technique.description: the technique answered for: the requested id, or its successor when revoked

refreshed_at.title: Refreshed At
refreshed_at.description: when the rows were last refreshed; the tests and signatures below are read now

rows.title: Rows
rows.description: the technique's rows, retired ones included

sub_technique_rows.title: Sub Technique Rows
sub_technique_rows.description: its sub-techniques' rows, retired ones included

tests.title: Tests
tests.description: the tests of the technique and its sub-techniques, per platform

manual_signatures_error.title: Manual Signatures Error
manual_signatures_error.description: why the signature tags couldn't be read; manual_signatures is then empty

removed_tests.title: Removed Tests
removed_tests.description: tests removed from their repository; they don't count

TechniqueCoverage.title: TechniqueCoverage
TechniqueCoverage.description: A technique's coverage: its rows as of the last refresh, and what counts toward them now.

usernames.title: Usernames
usernames.description: bare user names, lower case; empty means any user

hostname.title: Hostname
hostname.description: the short or fully qualified host name; a fully qualified one also sets fqdn

fqdn.title: Fqdn
fqdn.description: the fully qualified name, when the host has one. A target named by a fully qualified name matches only this one

usernames.title: Usernames
usernames.description: the users runs may use on the host, as user, DOMAIN\user or user@domain; empty means any user

platform.title: Platform
platform.description: one of windows, linux, macos, when known: a test that doesn't support it can't target the host

TestHostRequest.title: TestHostRequest
TestHostRequest.description: A test host as an svs:admin adds or replaces it. Names are matched case-insensitively.

observation_minutes.title: Observation Minutes
observation_minutes.description: the observation window of the test's runs registered from now on, used as it is (no slack, no floor), from 1 minute up to svs.runs.observation_window.ceiling_hours; null for the computed window

holds_host.title: Holds Host
holds_host.description: the test leaves something behind on its hosts, so each run of it registered from now on holds them until its attribution window ends, not its observation window (docs/SVS_RUNS.md, *One run per test host*)

TestSettingsRequest.title: TestSettingsRequest
TestSettingsRequest.description: A test's settings, as svs:run_manage sets them.

UserSelfUpdate.title: UserSelfUpdate
UserSelfUpdate.description:
The fields a user may change on their OWN account from the preferences page. Username,
email, password and enablement stay with the admin endpoints (and the change-password
page), so this is deliberately not UserUpdate with the id removed.

requested_by.title: Requested By
requested_by.description: the user whose key requested it

compile_errors.title: Compile Errors
compile_errors.description: the head's rule files that do not compile, plus one if its ruleset would not load

attempts.title: Attempts
attempts.description: how many times a worker has claimed it

claimed_by.title: Claimed By
claimed_by.description: the node that ran (or runs) it

corpus_version.title: Corpus Version
corpus_version.description: what the samples and their labels were when it ran

engine_fingerprint.title: Engine Fingerprint
engine_fingerprint.description: what decided its results besides the corpus and the commits

report.title: Report
report.description: how each commit compiled, the rules added, removed and changed, the rules that cannot be tested, the samples skipped and the timings; its listed pairs are GET …/results

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: pass as ?cursor= with the same filters for the next page; null on the last page

repository.title: Repository
repository.description: the name of a git_repo_* section (its name field), listed in svs.yara.repositories

base_sha.title: Base Sha
base_sha.description: the full id of the commit to compare against: the pull request's merge base

head_sha.title: Head Sha
head_sha.description: the full id of the commit to validate

pr_url.title: Pr Url
pr_url.description: the pull request, for the report's link back

ValidationRequest.title: ValidationRequest
ValidationRequest.description: What the signature repository's CI asks for: validate head_sha against base_sha.

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: pass as ?cursor= with the same filters for the next page; null on the last page

base.title: Base
base.description: the outcome under base_sha: match (the rule would make a detection), miss or error

raw_base.title: Raw Base
raw_base.description: whether the rule matched under base at all, before enabled and the qa/no_alert modifiers

ValidationResultRow.title: ValidationResultRow
ValidationResultRow.description: One (sample, rule uuid) pair the report lists, with the sample's label when it ran.

requested_by.title: Requested By
requested_by.description: the user whose key requested it

compile_errors.title: Compile Errors
compile_errors.description: the head's rule files that do not compile, plus one if its ruleset would not load

ValidationRow.title: ValidationRow
ValidationRow.description: One validation in the listing (signature:read). Timestamps are UTC.

error.title: Error
error.description: why a failed validation could not run

diffed.title: Diffed
diffed.description: false when either commit's ruleset would not load, so nothing was compared

counts.title: Counts
counts.description: pairs (sample, rule uuid) per category, every category included; set once completed

rules.title: Rules
rules.description: the rules with samples in each listed category, most samples first

compile_errors.title: Compile Errors
compile_errors.description: the head's rule files that do not compile; their rules are dropped

ruleset_error.title: Ruleset Error
ruleset_error.description: set when the head's rules would not load together: production keeps its previous rules

report_path.title: Report Path
report_path.description: the report in the ACE GUI, relative to the GUI's host

ValidationStatus.title: ValidationStatus
ValidationStatus.description:
A validation as the signature repository's CI sees it (svs:validate): its state, counts, and
rule names and uuids. It never carries a sample's sha256, file name or content.

status.title: Status
status.description: the row's status, which can't be resolved

technique.title: Technique
technique.description: the technique in the pinned ATT&CK release (a revoked tag id counts as its successor)

technique_name.title: Technique Name
technique_name.description: its name in the pinned release

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: declared (a tag of the signature), undeclared (measured, but no tag names it) or unknown (a tag naming an id the release doesn't have)

status.title: Status
status.description: confirmed, open, kept, remove_pending, removed, undeclared, unknown or retired

declared_as.title: Declared As
declared_as.description: the tag ids, as the signature writes them, that count as the technique

tag_present.title: Tag Present
tag_present.description: the signature has the tag now

signature_counts.title: Signature Counts
signature_counts.description: the signature is enabled, and isn't a YARA rule in QA mode

counts.title: Counts
counts.description: the tag counts toward coverage as a manual mapping (from the next refresh, after a resolution)

measured.title: Measured
measured.description: the signature is expected of a catalog test

measured_techniques.title: Measured Techniques
measured_techniques.description: the techniques the signature is measured on

resolution.title: Resolution
resolution.description: keep or remove; null when nobody resolved the row

reference.title: Reference
reference.description: a link, such as the pull request removing the tag

resolved_by.title: Resolved By
resolved_by.description: the username of whoever resolved it

updated_at.title: Updated At
updated_at.description: when the row last changed; the changed_since key

WorklistRow.title: WorklistRow
WorklistRow.description:
One signature's tag on, or measurement of, one ATT&CK technique, as of the last coverage
refresh (the resolution as of now).
